_comment: Handlers for the `system` routine action (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3, §7). The handler REGISTRY is Swift (RoutineSystemHandlerID.known in Routines/RoutineContent.swift, wrapping the ScheduledJobExecutor descriptors); this file owns each handler's label, default schedule and defaultEnabled. An id Swift doesn't know is ignored; a known id missing here keeps its frozen Swift default. defaultEnabled mirrors today's intended first-launch defaults (ScheduledJobExecutor.firstLaunchDefaults: AmbientObserver daily 9:30, CCAA daily 10:00, HealthMonitor hourly) and SchedulerService.loadSavedJob's defaults for the rest (off, daily 8:00). It replaces the broken bootstrap (D2) from R3; on a Mac where D2 already left these jobs off, R3's GATE 2 asks the owner before applying it. System routines never wake the app (§9 decision 1): whenAppClosed is waitForApp. Checked by mchatai_macOS/scripts/check_routine_content.py.

handlers.summary: Builds the Daily For You brief from your web updates, research and opportunities.
handlers.notes: Off until the Personal Assistant toggle turns it on (AssistantRoutine.dailyBriefDefault). The single daily-brief row in AssistantStore.routines stays mirrored for iOS; nothing else is ever written there.
Hourly (the scheduler cadence). The 5-minute cycle belongs to SystemHealthMonitorService's own timer, not to this routine.

handlers.summary: Summarizes the sites you track in AI Web.
handlers.notes: Off by default, as today. With no tracked sites a run records skipped: noChanges.

handlers.summary: Polls for cross-machine content-factory jobs and runs the highest-priority one it can claim (DEBUG builds).
Nightly QA flywheel pass over the catalog.
handlers.notes: Today SelfLearnCoordinator schedules itself from harness/self-learn/config.json (cadence.cron, enabled:false) behind the selfLearnNightly flag. As a routine it keeps that flag and gains catch-up.
